title: FoundationDB #13866: RangeDigest
claims: Merged to main; commit c3787dfbddee2e8afc670ba52bf8b7bf20d6fab0.
Storage-server-side SHA-256 leaf hashes summed modulo 2^256 give partition-independent content fingerprints.
Requires stopped writes and moving_data=0; not adversarial collision-resistant and not an online pinned-snapshot audit.
No released-version evidence established.
The additive combine is associative and commutative but requires every key-value to be counted exactly once.
Rate limiting and batching reuse existing audit controls; server-side hashing still scans the data.
access_notes: Read live GitHub REST pull detail and files endpoint, including design/range-digest.md. Browser fetch of PR page returned cache miss. No benchmark reproduced; no speedup ratio used.

title: JuiceFS #7476: exact SQL edge identity
claims: Merged to main; commit 5f250030ec437d6c676355e7a99f92b8ec480747.
Checks full edge identity and affected rows, retrying when stale SQL directory entries have been replaced.
PR helper tests cover stale-identity, ABA and rollback; PR explicitly does not claim concurrent public API end-to-end testing.
Duplicate-name handling is separate PR #7526; not claimed as part of this PR.
SQL helper matches inode, type and optional edge row ID, with affected-row checks; conceptual timeline in article is derived from PR description, not a reproduced concurrent test.
access_notes: Read live REST detail and pkg/meta/sql.go patch. web cached HTML crawled six days earlier still said Open and contained an older scope; current API merged_at and body used for status and final scope.

title: JuiceFS #7500: abandoned fetch must not turn failure into success
claims: Merged to main; commit 0e5cb0c8a74f75553af5b51050925dbd7332772e.
Late async callback could overwrite named return error after timeout.
Separate GET result state is accepted only after successful WithTimeout; load and loadRange changed.
This does not prove all timeout/buffer-lifetime races fixed.

The named-return corruption window is during return/defer before final return; no claim that an already-delivered return value changes retroactively. Article timing example is a mechanism illustration, not a reproduced trace.
access_notes: Read live REST detail and pkg/chunk/cached_store.go patch. No local reproduction performed.

Moves pool capability detection into actual dedup processing and skips work when pool absent.
PR checklist says no added tests; no release inclusion verified.

title: WriteGuards: Distributed Storage Support for Strongly Consistent Caches
claims: Official conference proceedings cover confirms July 13–15 2026; presentation BibTeX month jul.
Range-based guards checked by storage reject writes from previous cache owners.
Read motivation and core Sections 4–6; implementation uses TiDB and coordinated ownership; not a drop-in TTL mechanism.
Core Section 6.2 constrains SetGuard to start and complete within one ownership interval, non-overlapping calls for a key, and fresh unique values including retries.
A data OCC version check can still admit a previous owner write when the new owner has only read and cached an unchanged version.
access_notes: Opened official presentation, PDF and relevant sections; did not reproduce performance results or perform exhaustive full-paper evaluation.
